methodology: Structure-to-label attribution audit: each verified label's composition is reduced-formula matched against the structure-bearing Materials Project backbone. 'structure_attached' means a DFT structure of the same reduced formula exists and is what featurization pairs with the label (this structure is from MP, NOT from the measurement paper — the documented systematic borrow our architecture makes). 'n_mp_structures_for_formula' counts distinct polymorph structures, exposing ambiguity about which polymorph the label was measured on.
interpretation: Structure borrowing is systematic and documented here: labeled rows carry an MP DFT structure of the same composition, not the paper's own structure. Labels with no MP structure match have no structure at all (honest gap). Labels matching a formula with multiple MP polymorphs are ambiguous about which polymorph was measured — model cards should caveat this.
